metadata.question: Are more floating solar panels visible on February 10, 2023, than on January 30, 2025, on a reservoir of the Narmada River in central India?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use Sentinel-1 GRD (SAR) for robustness to clouds.
- Location: Omkareshwar Reservoir on the Narmada River (central India), approx near 22.25N, 76.15E; analyze a 15 km radius region.
- Dates: center windows at 2023-02-10 and 2025-01-30. Try ±20 days; if empty, widen to ±45 days.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- SAR doesn’t need cloud masking. Restrict analysis to water using JRC Global Surface Water occurrence > 25%.
- Identify floating solar as bright scatterers (VV_dB > -17 dB) on water, after median temporal composite and 30 m focal median smoothing.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections are empty for either date after fallback → C1.
- If water mask yields 0 pixels → C2.
- If any reduceRegion result is null/NaN → C3.
- Otherwise, compare bright area (m²) on water between dates. If 2023 > 2025 → A; else → B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roiCenter = ee.Geometry.Point([76.15, 22.25]); // Omkareshwar Reservoir vicinity
    const geom = roiCenter.buffer({distance: 15000}).bounds(); // ~15 km radius
    const dateA = '2023-02-10';
    const dateB = '2025-01-30';

    // 2. Water Mask (JRC) and basic checks
    const gsw = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater').select('occurrence');
    const water = gsw.gt(25).selfMask().clip(geom);
    const waterCount = await water.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('occurrence').getInfo();
    const waterAreaM2 = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(water).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('area').getInfo();
    if (!waterCount || waterCount === 0 || waterAreaM2 === null) {
      console.log(`Water pixels (1km): ${waterCount || 0}, Water area km2: ${((waterAreaM2||0)/1e6).toFixed(2)}`);
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Sentinel-1 helper: get composite around target date
    async function fetchS1Composite(dateStr) {
      const date = ee.Date(dateStr);
      async function attempt(windowDays) {
        const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
          .filterBounds(geom)
          .filterDate(date.advance(-windowDays, 'day'), date.advance(windowDays, 'day'))
          .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
          .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV'))
          .filter(ee.Filter.eq('resolution_meters', 10))
          .select(['VV']);
        const size = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (size && size > 0) {
          const img = col.median().clip(geom);
          return { img, size, window: windowDays };
        }
        return { img: null, size: 0, window: windowDays };
      }
      let res = await attempt(20);
      if (!res.img) res = await attempt(45);
      return res;
    }

    const s1A = await fetchS1Composite(dateA);
    const s1B = await fetchS1Composite(dateB);
    if (!s1A.img || !s1B.img) {
      console.log(`S1 ${dateA}: images=${s1A.size}, window=±${s1A.window}d`);
      console.log(`S1 ${dateB}: images=${s1B.size}, window=±${s1B.window}d`);
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
      return;
    }

    function brightOnWater(img) {
      const vv_db = img.select('VV').log10().multiply(10).rename('VV_dB');
      const vv_db_smooth = vv_db.focal_median({radius: 30, units: 'meters'});
      const bright = vv_db_smooth.gt(-17).selfMask().updateMask(water);
      return bright;
    }

    async function statsFor(img, label, size, windowDays) {
      const brightMask = brightOnWater(img);
      const brightAreaM2 = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(brightMask).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('area').getInfo();
      const brightCount = await brightMask.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('VV_dB').getInfo();
      const areaM2 = brightAreaM2 || 0;
      const frac = waterAreaM2 > 0 ? areaM2 / waterAreaM2 : null;
      if (frac === null || isNaN(frac)) return { ok: false };
      console.log(`S1 ${label}: images=${size}, window=±${windowDays}d, Bright area km2=${(areaM2/1e6).toFixed(3)} (${(frac*100).toFixed(3)}%), 1km-px=${brightCount||0}`);
      return { ok: true, areaM2: areaM2, frac: frac };
    }

    console.log(`Water pixels (1km): ${waterCount}, Water area km2: ${(waterAreaM2/1e6).toFixed(2)}`);
    const stA = await statsFor(s1A.img, dateA, s1A.size, s1A.window);
    const stB = await statsFor(s1B.img, dateB, s1B.size, s1B.window);

    if (!stA.ok || !stB.ok || stA.areaM2 === null || stB.areaM2 === null || isNaN(stA.areaM2) || isNaN(stB.areaM2)) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Final Answer
    const moreIn2023 = stA.areaM2 > stB.areaM2;
    console.log(moreIn2023 ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D: Processing/Code Error');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
